text:
sara_engineer: Quick question — I ended up staying an extra night after the EU Summit (had to cover a post-conference workshop) and bought dinner both Sat + Sun. Policy says per-diem for overnight travel, but this was a weekend extension. Can I claim the extra meals? I paid personally, will upload receipts shortly.

anna_finance: Hi Sara — generally per-diem applies to official overnight travel days. Weekend extensions are allowed as exceptions but need manager sign-off + docs. If total meal spend <= €50/day we can do standard per-diem, otherwise itemize. Upload receipts and add a brief note from your manager in the expense form. :memo:

sara_engineer: Thanks — I have receipts but a few are just card totals (no itemized). Is that ok? Also the total for Sat+Sun is €97 (so slightly over two days at €50/day).

anna_finance: Card totals are acceptable if they clearly show merchant, date, and amount. For amounts over per-diem, we need manager approval text saying this was required travel. If you prefer to claim per-diem flat-rate we can cap at €50/day (so €100) and any overage is reimbursed only with itemized receipts and approval.

leo_ops: I approved the extension — @anna_finance you can mark this as manager-approved for Sara. Confirming the extra day was required for the workshop. :white_check_mark:

sara_engineer: @leo_ops thanks! I'll attach receipts and the workshop agenda to the expense. Do I select "exception: manager-approved" in the form?

reimburse-bot: Please submit with category = "Travel: Meals (per-diem exception)" and include manager_approval=yes and upload receipts. Template: 
``
expense_type: per-diem-exception
dates: 2026-03-14 to 2026-03-15
amount_claimed: EUR 97
manager: leo_ops
notes: workshop extension required
```

anna_finance: Perfect — once submitted I'll process. If you want to take the flat-rate instead of itemizing, set amount_claimed = EUR 100 and include manager note; we'll auto-approve the flat cap.

sara_engineer: Submitted just now (ID 87921). Chose to itemize because one receipt had extra taxi. Thanks everyone :heart:

anna_finance: Got it, pulling the submission now. Will ping when it's reimbursed (usually 5–7 business days).
